candidates.name: yalqen
candidates.summary: An open-source Chromium browser for developers and an alternative to Arc, Chrome, Dia, Brave, Firefox, Zen, and Orion. Vertical tabs, a command bar, an AI panel, and built-in ad and tracker blocking. No browser account required. Available on macOS, with an experimental Linux preview.
